items.title: 1.8 Na aur Mg ke pani, oxygen aur chlorine se reactions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to topic 1.8, printed page 15.

blocks.text: Kitab is heading ke neeche koi alag text nahi deti; tafseel agle teen topics mein hai: 1.8.1 pani (water) ke saath, 1.8.2 oxygen ke saath aur 1.8.3 chlorine ke saath.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Sodium (group 1) aur magnesium (group 2) dono period 3 ke metals hain aur dono pani, oxygen aur chlorine se react karte hain, magar har jagah sodium zyada tezi se react karta hai. Wajah: sodium ka sirf ek valence electron hai, atom bara hai aur ionization energy kam, is liye woh electron asani se de deta hai (zyada metallic character).

blocks.prompt: Teen reactions parhne se pehle andaza lagayein: thande pani se sodium tez react karega ya magnesium? Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Sodium. Yeh magnesium se bara hai, is ki pehli ionization energy kam hai aur ise sirf ek electron dena hai, is liye yeh zyada metallic aur zyada reactive hai; sodium pani se zor se react karta hai jab ke magnesium aahista.

items: Sodium aur magnesium dono pani, oxygen aur chlorine se react karte hain; sodium zyada metallic character ki wajah se zyada reactive hai.
